title: 第5章 拾荒者营地
content_zh:
第5章 拾荒者营地
南凰洲东部这一隅之地所形成的禁区，并非很大。
而许青一行人离去的废墟，处于禁区的边缘。
这也是为何拾荒者能在阳光到来的第一天，就赶到城池的原因。
所以在天色渐晚时，他们已快要走出禁区的范围。
路上虽也遇到了一些异化之兽，但在这些拾荒者的出手中，都很快解决。
许青观察之下，心底有了判断。
他觉得自己出手的话，这六个拾荒者里，除了被称为雷队的老者，其他人自己都可以对抗一番。
“他们不是修士，但出手的狠辣与时机的把握，还有那关键时刻似不在乎死亡的态度，使他们的杀伤力增强。”
许青心底分析，他琢磨着除了雷队外，其他人单独一个，自己可战。
若是两个的话，自己也并非不可，但三个一起，自己怕是不行。
有了这个判断，许青越发谨慎。
同时也敏锐的察觉到，随着距离外界越来越近，那些拾荒者的表情，也轻松了不少。
甚至路上相互之间还时而说笑。
唯独被称为雷队的老者，一路没有任何话语。
而其他人对其也很是敬畏，这让许青对于老者的身份，有了好奇。
不过这好奇没有减少他的警觉，即便是如今快要走出禁区，但许青的警惕依旧，跟随这些拾荒者时，也没有完全靠近。
而是不近不远的在后方，一边听着他们的谈论，一边谨慎的随行。
直至天色快要完全落下时，随着一股温暖之意的扑面而来，许青脚步一顿，回头看了看身后的荒地，又看向前方的世界。
天地间，他所在的地方好似有一道看不见的界限。

界限内，是初成的禁区，阴冷冰寒。
界限外，是正常的世界，大地回春。
他们，走出了禁区。
外界虽是黑夜，但星空璀璨，能看见明月高挂。
大地虽也荒凉，但却远远没有禁区的阴冷，时而还能听见一些正常的鸟兽之声。
远处的草丛中，许青甚至都看到了一只兔子，在那里警惕的望着他们。
这一切让许青神色有些恍惚。
那些拾荒者也都明显神色彻底放松，就连雷队也都舒缓了一下眉头。
“终于走出来了，这一次还算顺利，但凡有可能，老子都不想再踏禁区半步。”
“不去禁区？这鬼世界想要活下去，想要活得更好一些，就必须去禁区拼命，早晚我会买一个七血瞳分城的居住权！”
禁区外，这些拾荒者显然是心情舒缓，彼此话语传出。
许青默不作声，但听得很仔细，这一路上他听这些人的谈话，已经知晓了很多以往接触不到的信息。
比如这七血瞳，他就听这些拾荒者多次提起，似乎那是一个很强大的势力。
还有紫土这个名字，也被他们说过数次。
“你就这点志气？七血瞳分城多了，旁边的鹿角城就是其一，不过那里的资格不是你灵币够了就可以买的，还需七血瞳弟子的推荐，况且那里的居住权算什么，我的目标是获得七血瞳的入门资格，成为七血瞳弟子！”
“你去了七血瞳，活不过三天，牛皮谁不会吹，你怎么不说你的目标是前往海外望古大陆呢，那里还有人族的起源地呢。”
许青听到这里，内心一动，他在竹简上看到过望古这个名称，
“望古？老子若有本事无视海中的那些禁忌之物，你以为我不去？”
拾荒者中的二人，彼此似有些言语冲突，相互杠了起来。
许青竖起耳朵，正要继续听他们对话获取信息，一旁的雷队老者，扫了那二人一眼，一路上首次开口，传出话语。

“想去望古大陆，也不是不可能，方法有四个，你们可以想想，哪一个适合自身。”
“一，十五岁以内筑基，成为不可多得的天骄。二，缴纳三十万钧灵币，从紫土或者七血瞳，又或者离途教购买迁徙名额。”
“三，在炼丹上对人族有杰出贡献。四，被紫土的几大家族，七血瞳的几位峰主，又或者离途教的教主，收为亲传弟子。”
“哦，还有第五个方法，成为养宝人。你们想想，适合哪个？”
拾荒者纷纷沉默，尤其是在听到第五个方法时，都各自神色很不自然，目中露出恐惧。
许青也是眼睛一凝，他听过养宝人这个称呼。
那是在贫民窟时，他曾经有几个熟悉的同伴，被一些衣着华贵之人带走。
据说就是要培养成为养宝人，当时贫民窟内其他的孩子，都还很羡慕。
于是他迟疑了一下，看向雷队老者，轻声问了一句。
“请问……什么是养宝人？”
雷队老者目光落在许青这里，平缓开口。
“以自己身体去蕴养法宝，修行特殊的功法，靠着血肉去稀释法宝的异质污染，使法宝每一次使用所带来的异质增高被缓和，以便持续使用，而自身逐渐枯败死亡之人。”
许青眼睛一缩，半晌说不出话语，沉默下来。
众人似乎也因养宝人这三个字，失去了谈意，默默的走在黑夜里。
直至离开了禁区一些距离后，在一处平原上，雷队选择了扎营。
与禁区不同，外界的扎营除了帐篷本身，还有被点燃的篝火。
随着火焰的燃烧，四周的暖意更强了一些，这些拾荒者也围坐在篝火旁，各自取出食物烘烤，渐渐香气四溢。
看着他们的食物，许青咽了下口水，坐在远处从皮袋里拿出半块坚硬的肉干，放在嘴里用力撕咬。
篝火旁的雷队，目光扫来，起身走到许青这里。
在许青猛地抬头中，雷队扔过来一个皮袋，里面有几个热热的馒头。

在看到这馒头的瞬间，许青眼睛都直了一下，强忍着冲动，低声开口。
“谢谢。”
雷队没说话，回到了篝火旁，其身边有拾荒者笑着传出话语。
“雷队，怎么对这小子这么好？”
“都是可怜人，遇到也是缘分，能帮就帮一把。”
馒头有三个，拿在手里很热。
许青犹豫了一下，看见火堆旁众人也在吃着同样的馒头，于是先是假装吃了一口，观察那些拾荒者，半晌发现他们依旧如常后，他忍了很久，才真的吃了一小口，含在嘴里等了片刻。
确定无碍，这才慢慢的咀嚼直至稀碎，缓缓咽下。
又等了许久，再次确定无碍后，他心底松了口气，再也忍不住，大口大口的吃下了一整个。
接着他迟疑了一下，又小口小口的将第二个也吃下。
虽肚子还饿，但他还是将最后一个馒头包起，小心的放在了自己的皮袋里，好似放置珍宝。
很快天色更晚，拾荒者也陆续回到帐篷内，雷队与昨日一样，将那睡袋递给了他，临走前说了一句话。
“送你了。”
许青抬头，看着雷队，忽然开口。
“为什么？”
“什么为什么？三个馒头，一个睡袋吗……没有为什么，你若有心，以后也给我弄点吃的就是。”雷队转身，向帐篷走去。
“你喜欢吃什么？”
“我？”雷队站在帐篷旁想了想。
“蛇吧，那玩意口感不错。”说完，他走入帐篷。
许青拿着睡袋，看着雷队的帐篷许久，重重的点了点头，钻入睡袋内闭上了眼。

但他没有立刻睡去，而是在闭目中默默运转海山诀，这已经成为了他的习惯。
即便是修行时冰寒无比，但他没有丝毫放弃，抓紧一切时间去努力修炼。
尤其是今天雷队所说的十五岁前筑基，他虽没有去与其话语里的那种天骄对比，但心底也还是有一些想法。
“我今年十四了……”许青喃喃，继续修炼。
就这样，时间慢慢流逝，很快五天过去。
许青跟着这些拾荒者，翻越了山岭，走过了草原。
路上有三人半途离开，这也印证了许青之前的判断，他们这些人，是临时组合在一起。
直至第七天时，两个拿刀的拾荒者也离开后，就只剩下了许青与雷队二人。
这天夜里，在一座山下，篝火旁，雷队老者望着小口小口吃完馒头，又将一半小心收好的许青，缓缓开口。
“小孩，明天晌午，我们就可以到目的地了，那是我居住的地方，是一个拾荒者聚集的营地。”
许青抬头，看向老者。
老者望着远处，继续开口。
“拾荒者的营地，往往都是建立在禁区旁，所以在山那一边的营地外，也是一处禁区。”
“相比于你之前所在的初成禁区，那里存在已久，其内不但有凶兽，更有险地，且异质极为浓郁，普通人进去一天若不出来，必定死亡，就算是我，在里面也最多能支撑七天。”
“但那里盛产七叶草，这是一种炼制白丹的必须之物。”
“白丹，就是修士用来化解自身异质的基础丹药，所以平日里很多外人来此，他们惜命，且不熟悉地理，很少亲自去采，更多是花费灵币让本地拾荒者进去采摘。”
老者说到这里，看了看许青。
“你明白我的意思么？”
“你的意思是，营地里的本地拾荒者，都是亡命徒，为了钱，什么都可以做。”
许青听到白丹以及其功效后，眯起了眼，思索后轻声开口。

雷队老者目中露出讶色，笑了笑。
“你回答的部分正确，我要告诉你的是，拾荒者的营地，规则就是弱肉强食，实力为上。”
“但至少也是一个居住之所，且有集市，有生活必须品的买卖之地，甚至时而还有商队过来，所以其内的屋舍，每一个也都有不小的价值。”
“故而不是任何人说进就可以进的，每一个生面孔想要获得居留的权利，都需要经历一场兽炼才可以，这是营主定下的规矩。”
“而你，如果成功通过，我可以允许你有偿居住在我那里。”老者望着许青，慢慢开口。
(本章完)
content_en:
Chapter 5 Scavenger Camp
The restricted area formed by this corner of the eastern part of Nanhuang Continent is not very large.
The ruins where Xu Qing and his group left were on the edge of the restricted area.
This is also the reason why scavengers can rush to the city on the first day of sunshine.
So when it was getting dark, they were almost out of the restricted area.
Although we encountered some alienated beasts on the road, they were all quickly dealt with by these scavengers.
After Xu Qing observed it, he made a judgment in his heart.
He felt that if he took action, among the six scavengers, except for the old man known as Team Lei, everyone else could fight against them.
"They are not monks, but their ruthlessness and timing, as well as their attitude of not caring about death at the critical moment, make them more lethal."
Xu Qing analyzed from the bottom of his heart, thinking that except for Lei Dui, the others could fight alone.
If there were two of them, I wouldn't be able to do it, but if there were three of them together, I'm afraid I wouldn't be able to do it.
With this judgment, Xu Qing became more cautious.
At the same time, I was also keenly aware that as they got closer and closer to the outside world, the expressions of the scavengers became much more relaxed.
They even joked with each other from time to time on the road.
Only the old man known as Team Lei didn't say anything during the whole journey.
Others were also in awe of him, which made Xu Qing curious about the old man's identity.
However, this curiosity did not reduce his vigilance. Even now that he was about to leave the restricted area, Xu Qing was still vigilant. When following these scavengers, he did not get completely close.
Instead, he stayed close to the rear, listening to their conversation while cautiously accompanying them.
When the sky was about to completely set, Xu Qing paused as a feeling of warmth hit his face. He looked back at the wasteland behind him and then looked at the world in front of him.
Between heaven and earth, there seemed to be an invisible boundary where he was.
Within the boundaries is the newly formed restricted area, which is cold and cold.
Outside the boundaries is the normal world, where the earth is rejuvenated.
They walked out of the restricted area.
Although it is dark outside, the starry sky is bright and the moon can be seen high.
Although the land is also desolate, it is far less cold than the restricted area. From time to time, you can still hear some normal sounds of birds and animals.
Xu Qing even saw a rabbit in the grass in the distance, watching them warily.
All this made Xu Qing look a little dazed.
The scavengers all looked completely relaxed, and even Team Lei relaxed their brows.
"I finally came out. It went smoothly this time. Whenever possible, I don't want to step into the restricted area again."
"Don't go to the restricted area? If you want to survive in this ghost world and live a better life, you must go to the restricted area and fight hard. Sooner or later, I will buy the right to live in the Seven Blood Pupils Branch City!"
Outside the restricted area, these scavengers were obviously in a relaxed mood and exchanged words.
Xu Qing was silent, but listened very carefully. He listened to these people's conversations along the way and already learned a lot of information that he had not been able to access before.
For example, the Seven Blood Pupils, he had heard these scavengers mention it many times, and it seemed that it was a very powerful force.
The name Zitu was also mentioned several times by them.
"You only have this ambition? Seven Blood Pupils has many cities, and the nearby Antler City is one of them. However, the qualifications there cannot be purchased with enough spirit coins. You also need the recommendation of the Seven Blood Pupils disciples. Besides, the right to live there is nothing. My goal is to obtain the entry qualification of Seven Blood Pupils and become a disciple of Seven Blood Pupils!"
"You went to Qixuetong and couldn't live more than three days. No one knows how to brag. Why didn't you say that your goal was to go overseas to Wanggu Continent, where the human race originated."
When Xu Qing heard this, his heart moved. He had seen the name Wanggu on the bamboo slips.
"Wang Gu? If I have the ability to ignore those forbidden things in the sea, do you think I won't go?"
The two scavengers seemed to have some differences with each other.There was a verbal conflict and they started to fight with each other.
Xu Qing pricked up his ears and was about to continue listening to their conversation to obtain information. The old man from Team Lei on the side glanced at the two people and spoke for the first time along the way.
"It's not impossible to visit the ancient continent. There are four ways. You can think about which one suits you."
"First, build a foundation within the age of fifteen and become a rare genius. Second, pay three hundred thousand Junling coins and purchase a migration quota from Zitu, Seven Blood Pupils, or Litaojiao."
"Third, he has made outstanding contributions to the human race in alchemy. Fourth, he has been accepted as a direct disciple by several major families of Zi Tu, several peak masters of Qixuetong, or the leader of the Li Tu Cult."
"Oh, there is also a fifth way, to become a treasure keeper. Think about it, which one is suitable?"
The scavengers fell silent, especially when they heard the fifth method. They all looked very unnatural, with fear in their eyes.
Xu Qing's eyes also narrowed. He had heard of the title of Treasure Raider.
That was when he was in the slums, and he had a few familiar companions who were taken away by some richly dressed people.
It was said that he was to be trained to become a treasure keeper. At that time, other children in the slum were still envious of him.
So he hesitated for a moment, looked at the old man from Team Lei, and asked softly.
"Excuse me...what is a treasure keeper?"
The old man from Team Lei's eyes fell on Xu Qing and he spoke calmly.
"Using one's own body to cultivate the magic weapon, practicing special skills, and relying on flesh and blood to dilute the heterogeneous pollution of the magic weapon, so that the heterogeneous increase caused by each use of the magic weapon is alleviated, so that it can be used continuously, and the person himself gradually withers and dies."
Xu Qing's eyes shrank, and he couldn't speak for a while, then fell silent.
Everyone seemed to have lost their interest in talking because of the three words "treasure keeper" and walked silently in the dark night.
It wasn't until some distance away from the penalty area that the Thunder team chose to camp on a plain.
Unlike the restricted area, camping in the outside world includes not only the tents themselves, but also lit bonfires.
As the fire burned, the surrounding warmth became stronger. These scavengers also sat around the bonfire, each taking out food to bake, and the aroma gradually filled the air.
Looking at their food, Xu Qing swallowed, sat far away and took out half a piece of hard dried meat from the leather bag, put it in his mouth and bit it hard.
The Lei team next to the bonfire glanced at him, got up and walked over to Xu Qing.
When Xu Qing raised his head suddenly, Captain Lei threw over a leather bag with several hot steamed buns in it.
The moment she saw the steamed bun, Xu Qing's eyes straightened, she resisted the urge and spoke in a low voice.
"Thank you."
Team Lei didn't say anything and returned to the campfire. The scavengers beside him smiled and spoke.
"Team Lei, why are you so nice to this guy?"
"They are all poor people. It is fate that we meet them. Please help if you can."
There are three steamed buns, and they are very hot in your hand.
Xu Qing hesitated for a moment and saw that everyone around the fire was eating the same steamed buns, so he pretended to take a bite and observed the scavengers. After a while, he found that they were still the same as usual. He endured it for a long time before actually taking a small bite and holding it in his mouth for a while.
After making sure it was okay, he chewed it slowly until it was broken into pieces and swallowed it slowly.
After waiting for a long time and once again confirming that it was okay, he breathed a sigh of relief. He couldn't hold it back anymore and ate the whole thing in big gulps.
Then he hesitated for a moment, and then ate the second one in small bites.
Although he was still hungry, he still wrapped up the last steamed bun and carefully placed it in his leather bag, as if it were a treasure.
Soon it was getting darker, and the scavengers returned to the tent one after another. Like yesterday, Team Lei handed him the sleeping bag and said a few words before leaving.
"Give it to you."
Xu Qing raised his head, looked at Lei Dui, and suddenly spoke.
"Why?"
"Why? Three steamed buns and a sleeping bag... There is no reason. If you are willing, just get me some food in the future.. "Lei Tui turned around and walked towards the tent.
"What do you like to eat? "
"I? "Team Lei stood by the tent and thought for a while.
"Snake, that thing tastes good. "After that, he walked into the tent.
Xu Qing held the sleeping bag and looked at Team Lei's tent for a long time. He nodded heavily, got into the sleeping bag and closed his eyes.
But he did not fall asleep immediately. Instead, he closed his eyes and silently performed the Haishan Jue. This had become his habit.
Even though it was extremely cold while practicing, he did not give up at all and seized all the time to practice hard.
Especially what Captain Lei said today about building a foundation before the age of fifteen. Although he didn't compare it with the genius in his words, he still had some thoughts in his heart.
"I'm fourteen this year..." Xu Qing murmured and continued practicing.
In this way, time passed slowly, and five days passed quickly.
Xu Qing followed these scavengers over the mountains and across the grasslands.
Three people left halfway on the road, which confirmed Xu Qing's previous judgment that they were temporarily grouped together.
On the seventh day, after the two scavengers with knives also left, only Xu Qing and Lei Dui were left.
That night, at the foot of a mountain, beside a bonfire, the old man from the Lei team watched Xu Qing finish the steamed buns in small bites, carefully put away half of them, and spoke slowly.
"Kid, we can reach our destination at noon tomorrow. That's where I live, and it's a camp where scavengers gather. "
Xu Qing raised his head and looked at the old man.
The old man looked into the distance and continued to speak.
“Scavengers’ camps are often built next to restricted areas, so there is also a restricted area outside the camp on the other side of the mountain. "
"Compared to the Chucheng Forbidden Zone you were in before, it has existed there for a long time. Not only are there ferocious beasts, but also dangerous places, and it is extremely heterogeneous. If an ordinary person goes in for a day and does not come out, he will surely die. Even I can only survive in it for seven days at most. "
“But there’s a lot of horse chestnut there, which is a must for refining white elixir. "
"White elixir is the basic elixir used by monks to resolve their own heterogeneity, so many outsiders come here on weekdays. They cherish their lives and are not familiar with the geography. They rarely go to pick it in person. Most of them spend spiritual coins to let local scavengers go in to pick it. "
When the old man said this, he looked at Xu Qing.
"Do you understand what I mean? "
“What you mean is that the local scavengers in the camp are all desperadoes and will do anything for money. "
After Xu Qing heard about Baidan and its effects, he narrowed his eyes, thought about it and spoke softly.
The old man from Team Lei had a look of surprise in his eyes and smiled.
"Part of your answer is correct. What I want to tell you is that in the scavenger camp, the rule is that the weak will eat the strong, and strength will prevail. "
“But at least it is a place to live, and there is a market, a place for buying and selling daily necessities, and even caravans come from time to time, so every house in it has a lot of value. "
"So it's not just anyone who wants to come in. Every stranger who wants to get the right to stay needs to go through an animal training. This is the rule set by the camp owner. "
“And you, if you successfully pass, I can allow you to live in my place for a fee. "The old man looked at Xu Qing and spoke slowly.
(End of chapter)
